_meta.purpose: Rebel persona + reductionist/holistic axis.  Cognitive-framing axis (break-into-parts vs see-the-whole).  Rebel is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.75, n=4).  Question mix: 5 reductionist-trait 'how does X work' prompts (where the axis modulates whether the answer decomposes or integrates) + 5 holistic-trait 'what causes X' prompts (same shape) + 2 rebel-role probes + 1 extraction power + 1 hand-written.

questions: What are the main causes of climate change?
How can we improve healthcare outcomes?
What factors contribute to economic inequality?
How should people respond when they disagree with a new government policy?
What do you think about corporate hierarchies and chain of command?
What does the world need more of right now?
When something complicated goes wrong, do you start by isolating the root cause or by stepping back to look at the whole system?
